passages.note: House Third Reading vote on HB2492 (2022): Hernandez A voted No, 31-26-3-0-0.

passages.provision_quote: Is a citizen of the United States and has provided SATISFACTORY evidence of CITIZENSHIP as PRESCRIBED in section 16-166 .
passages.note: Chapter 99 (HB2492, 2022) amends A.R.S. 16-101 to require satisfactory evidence of citizenship for registration, the provision Hernandez A voted No on.

rows.reasoning: Hernandez A voted No on HB2492 (2022), a single-subject bill whose operative text requires registrants to have 'provided SATISFACTORY evidence of CITIZENSHIP' — the documentary-proof-of-citizenship clause of rung 5. A No vote shows only that she opposed that requirement; per V4.2 ruling out rung 5 does not by itself establish which of rungs 1-4 she holds.
